elements.label: Mouse cursor sweeping down across the status lozenge column
Templates row hover state (tint and remove 'x' icon flash on, then clear as cursor passes)

pattern.description: Screen recording: the cursor drifts down over the delivery tickets' status lozenges, triggering transient row hover states, as the narration wraps up 'directly from Jira Product Discovery'.
pattern.why_premium: Minor idle cursor motion; the premium element is restraint: the UI stays still so the newly added ticket and status column read clearly while the line lands.

build_hint.remotion: Cursor y via interpolate(frame,[start,start+15],[y0,y1],{easing:Easing.inOut(Easing.sin),extrapolateRight:'clamp'}); row hover tint and remove icon rendered while frame < start+6.

notes: Low-value event: cursor movement and hover feedback only. b02 is a union box over the cursor's path through the lozenge column, not a tight cursor box; the cursor in the end frame has moved off to the lower panel area. b01 text names the lozenge inside the hovered row. No SFX candidates.
